summary: Independently reviewed serialized refresh-token claim/rotation, successor creation in one transaction, consumed-token reuse detection and validation-before-update containment of only the affected same-user/client successor chain. Corrupt/cyclic/missing links deny without a partial sweep, independent lineages remain intact, and caller identity/grant inputs cannot widen scope. The retained 15 native refresh-family witnesses and current regression definitions cover replay, races, rollback and exact abort behavior; current required files match the prior cc62682 integrated review.
limitations: Bounded refresh-family integrity and containment only. This does not claim per-family access-token revocation, fine-grained consent, native-session rechecks on every effect, provider rollout, installation, full user journey or release acceptance. Fifteen native witnesses are historical retained evidence, not a newly executed campaign. Native prerequisite #206 and exact final-main CI remain required.

criteria.criterion: AISEC-014: Rotate refresh tokens safely, detect reuse and revoke affected families without widening scope.
criteria.basis: Independent current-source review plus unchanged retained qualification. Final acceptance revision CI is checked separately by the completion gate.

findings: Rotation uses the shared grant lock and atomic live/unrevoked/unexpired claim, then inserts the successor inside the transaction.
Replayed consumed roots/intermediates identify only their validated same-user/client successor chain; complete chain integrity is checked before containment updates.
Unknown tokens/wrong clients are denied without changing independent lineages. Concurrency and insertion/containment failures have retained native regression evidence.
Containment commits its denial result rather than throwing it and rolling back the revocation. No new capabilities, resources or user/client identity are issued by rotation.

retained_evidence.status: Historical supporting evidence only; no CI result claimed for the eventual new acceptance revision.

provenance_limit: GitHub authenticates the later delegated posting principal only. This actual Codex review task and retained report are process provenance, not an independently authenticated GitHub reviewer.
